Here are reliable places to buy niche fragrances online in Kuwait (with delivery to Kuwait). I’ve grouped them by “based in Kuwait/GCC” vs “international that ship to Kuwait,” since shipping, customs and returns can vary.

## Kuwait / GCC options (usually fastest delivery)
- **Boutiqaat (Kuwait)** – Large selection of perfumes and some niche lines; frequent promos.  
  https://www.boutiqaat.com
- **Faces (Kuwait / GCC)** – Carries higher-end and niche-leaning brands; delivers in Kuwait.  
  https://www.faces.com (choose Kuwait)
- **Sephora Middle East (Kuwait)** – Not fully “niche,” but has some premium fragrance and discovery sets.  
  https://www.sephora.com.kw
- **Ounass (UAE, delivers to Kuwait)** – Curated luxury/niche picks; good for premium gifting/packaging.  
  https://www.ounass.ae
- **Tryano (UAE, may deliver to Kuwait depending on item)** – Designer + some niche; check shipping at checkout.  
  https://www.tryano.com
- **Golden Scent (KSA/UAE, delivers to Kuwait)** – Wide range including regional niche/indie brands; frequent discounts.  
  https://www.goldenscent.com
- **Nice One (KSA, ships to Kuwait)** – Often good pricing and availability; check authenticity/return policy per listing.  
  https://niceonesa.com

## International niche retailers that commonly ship to Kuwait
(Delivery times and duties may apply.)
- **Luckyscent (US)** – Great for hard-to-find niche and samples/decants.  
  https://www.luckyscent.com
- **Twisted Lily (US)** – Niche + samples/discovery sets.  
  https://www.twistedlily.com
- **Jovoy Paris (France)** – Strong niche catalog; ships internationally.  
  https://www.jovoyparis.com
- **Essenza Nobile (Germany)** – Good selection + samples; ships internationally.  
  https://www.essenza-nobile.de
- **Selfridges (UK)** / **Harrods (UK)** – Luxury department stores with niche fragrance sections; international shipping varies.  
  https://www.selfridges.com / https://www.harrods.com

## Tips to avoid fakes / hassles
- Prefer **official retailers** or well-known department stores.
- Check **return policy** on opened fragrance (often restricted).
- For blind buys, prioritize stores that sell **samples/discovery sets** (Luckyscent, Twisted Lily, Essenza Nobile).

If you tell me (1) your budget, (2) what style you like (fresh/woody/amber/oud/gourmand), and (3) whether you want **samples** or a full bottle, I can suggest the best site(s) and specific niche brands available to Kuwait.
